en.title: Air Canada Boosts Mobility Aid Accessibility Amid Global Disability Access Advances
en.summary: Air Canada has introduced a new mobility aid policy to improve handling and storage of wheelchairs and other devices for disabled passengers. Meanwhile, Florida launched silent 911 text services for deaf residents, and international theater programs expanded deaf‑hearing integration. A new communication board in Jefferson City’s park supports speech‑disabled users, while advocates call for greater media representation of invisible disabilities.

highlights.title: Air Canada introduces new mobility aid policy to improve accessibility and passenger experience
Accessibility in emergencies: Florida’s silent 911 lifelines
Deaf Culture Breaks Through Accessibility Services: International Theater Programs Promote Deaf-Hearing Integration
New communication board brings more accessibility to Jefferson City's Community Park
Call for Representation of Invisible Disabilities

zh-TW.title: 加拿大航空新政策提升無障礙旅行
zh-TW.summary: 加拿大航空推出新行動輔助設備政策，以改善輪椅等輔具的處理與存放，提升殘障乘客的旅行體驗。佛羅里達州同時啟動靜默911簡訊服務，讓聾人與聽障居民能夠透過文字聯絡緊急救援。此外，國際劇場節目促進聾聽共融，杰斐遜城社區公園設置溝通板協助語言障礙者，並有呼籲媒體增加無形殘障的代表性。
